answer.summary: In this 2026-08-24 sample, recurring operational failures that practitioners discuss in public forums almost always already appear in the vendor issue tracker or in the MCP spec. After independence collapse, zero rows met the forum-only treat-as-real bar. The required collapse-to-one control is F-HN-CONTEXT-MODE-MCP-INTERCEPT (three search permalinks plus the empirical comment collapse to one reporter). Closest forum-only candidate F-HOOK-USER-CONSENT-BYPASS also collapsed to one reporter via a quote-reply.

methodology.negative_search_caveat: Vendor-absence is a dated negative search of the named doc and tracker URLs, not a proof that a filing does not exist under a different title.
methodology.treat_as_real_rule: A failure may be treated as real only when independent_reporter_count >= 2 after independence collapse AND vendor_doc_present is false AND vendor_tracker_present is false. Shared-primitive restatements are one signal (05-ECO section 6 npm/PyPI/Homebrew OIDC example). Reporters quoting one another are one reporter.
